title: Seed Protect
description: Hate that when you jump or even just walk on crops they instantly break and you have to replant them again? This mod fixes this issue and also makes sure that mobs cant break ur crops either.
body:
Seed Protect stops farmland trampling by players and mobs, so your crops never get uprooted accidentally. Install and forget — no commands, no items, no configuration. [![Available for Fabric](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/fabric_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/seed-protect/versions?l=fabric) [![Available for Forge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/forge_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/seed-protect/versions?l=forge) [![Available for NeoForge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/neoforge_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/seed-protect/versions?l=neoforge) [![Available for Quilt](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/quilt_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/seed-protect/versions?l=quilt) [![Donate](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/kofi-singular_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/U2P522M1IW) ## 📦 Installation 1. Make sure you have the correct mod loader installed: **Fabric**, **Forge**, or **NeoForge**. 2. Place the `seedprotect-.jar` file into the `mods` folder. - For **single‑player** or **LAN** games, put it in your client’s `.minecraft/mods` folder. - For **dedicated servers**, install on the server only; clients do not need the mod. 3. Start the game or server. The mod activates automatically — no further steps. ## ✨ Features - **Trampling protection** — farmland never reverts to dirt when a player or mob walks or falls on it, so your crops stay rooted. - **Jump‑safe crops** — no more losing newly planted seeds because you accidentally jumped nearby. - **Mob‑proof fields** — animals, villagers, zombies, and other creatures can wander through your farmland without uprooting anything. - **Works instantly** — no items, commands, or config files needed. Install and you’re done. - **Fall damage untouched** — jumping on farmland still hurts as in vanilla; only the dirt conversion is blocked. - **Server‑friendly** — for dedicated servers, only the server needs the mod; clients can join without it. The Fabric variant uses a common mixin that works on both sides seamlessly. - **Startup greeting** — prints a mod info card in the log on launch, crediting the author and contributor.

Even after a heavy landing, the wheat survives.
## 🧩 Compatibility | Minecraft | Fabric | Forge | NeoForge | |-----------|--------|-------|----------| | 1.20.1 | ✅ | ✅ | — | | 1.21.1 | ✅ | — | ✅ | | 1.21.11 | ✅ | — | — | | 26.1.2 | ✅ | — | — | **Dependencies:** None. No other mods are required. **Known incompatibilities:** None. Works alongside any mod that doesn’t drastically alter farmland mechanics. ## ❓ FAQ **Does this need to be installed on the server?** Yes. On dedicated servers, only the server needs Seed Protect; clients can join without it. For single‑player, place it in your client mods folder — the integrated server runs there. **Does this prevent fall damage?** No. Only the farmland‑to‑dirt conversion is stopped. Entities still take full fall damage when landing on farmland. **Will it break my existing farms?** No. Existing farmland and crops remain unchanged. The mod simply prevents new trampling. **Is this compatible with mods that add new crops?** Yes, as long as those crops use vanilla farmland. The trample event / mixin is cancelled globally. **Where do I report bugs?** Please open an issue on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/ModItamio/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aseedprotect) and include your Minecraft version, mod loader, and any crash logs. ## 🐛 Reporting Issues Found a problem? Let us know on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/ModItamio/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aseedprotect). Include your Minecraft version, mod loader, and a log file so we can help quickly. ## 💖 Support the Project Seed Protect is a free and open‑source mod maintained by **Itamio** with contributions from **Asd1281yss**. If you’d like to support development, you can buy us a coffee: [![Donate](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/kofi-singular_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/U2P522M1IW) ## 📝 License & Modpacks Licensed under **MIT**.
